name: Absolute Zero
description: Slowness IV for 3 seconds. A target showing signs of cold (slowed, brittle, frozen skin, held) freezes solid and takes damage for each: 4.5 for one, 7 for two, 9.5 for three, 12 for four, and is held 1.5 to 3 seconds (half as long on players), then not again until 3 seconds after it thaws.

name: Accelerate
description: Time runs faster for 10 seconds: Speed II, Haste III, Jump Boost II and Regeneration, and your spells charge 40% faster and your bolts and arcs fly 50% faster.

name: Accord
description: Enemies within 16 blocks are pacified for 10 seconds and no monster spawns there meanwhile. Not bosses.

name: Aegis
description: You and allies within 6 blocks take half damage and none from missiles for 6 seconds. Rests 2 minutes.

name: Aftercare
description: For 15 seconds, each time the target is hurt it heals 1 a second later, 6 in all.

name: Aftershock
description: 5 damage, then half a second later the same spot is struck again for 5: whoever is still there takes it.

name: Agestone
description: Ages masonry near the point: moss on cobblestone and stone bricks, cracks in deep bricks. 9 at most.

name: Air Pocket
description: Refills your air.

name: Anchor
description: Holds you fast for 15 seconds: blows and blasts can't knock you back, no spell can move you, and 4 more armour (8 once you've stood still a second).

name: Ancient Seed
description: Plants an ancient seed at the point: a torchflower or pitcher plant blooms, and crops within 4 blocks grow a stage now and every 3 seconds for 12 seconds more.

name: Angler's Lure
description: Your fishing bobber within 32 blocks: the wait for a bite is cut in half, leaving at least 1 second. Once per bobber.

name: Appraise
description: Reads a villager: their trade, their level, and how many of their trades are sold out.

name: Arrowveil
description: A 4-block dome for 10 seconds: enemy missiles inside drop out of the air.

name: Ashen Mercy
description: Extinguishes an ally and removes harmful conditions, converting only actual conditions removed into at most four restored health. Gives five seconds of heat protection. At most eight allies, once per target and paid cast; clean targets receive no healing.

name: Ashen Veil
description: Wreathes the target in ash for 10 seconds: fire can't hurt it, and whatever strikes it up close is set alight for 4 seconds and blinded by the ash for a second.

name: Avalanche
description: Snow and ice crash down round where it lands: 6 damage to every enemy within 3 blocks (half again on a bare head), buried in snow (Slowness III for 3 seconds). Drifts of snow lie where it fell for 10 seconds.

name: Axolotl Kinship
description: Axolotls within 12 blocks are healed and follow you for 30 seconds.

name: Bait Blessing
description: Luck for 60 seconds, Luck II with Amplify. Fishing reads your luck, so better catches come a little more often.

name: Bakehouse
description: Bakes from your inventory: three wheat into bread, then a pumpkin, sugar and an egg into a pie. Up to 4 bakes (8 at double power).

name: Banish
description: Banishes targets: they vanish and reappear up to 8 blocks further away from you, dazed.

name: Barkhide
description: Skin like old oak: Resistance I for 12 seconds.

name: Barkstrip
description: Strips the bark off the logs and wood in a 5-by-5-by-5 block around the point, as an axe would.

name: Barnwarmth
description: A hearth's warmth heals the farm animals and your pets within 5 blocks by 4 (more with power).

name: Barrier
description: A thin barrier of light: 2 absorption hearts for 20 seconds.

name: Basalt Surge
description: Basalt columns burst up in a line from you to the point: 7 damage and a toss into the air for everything along it.

name: Basinfill
description: Fills an enclosed, one-block-deep hole with permanent source water: at most 16 connected cells, within three blocks of the impact. Aim at its floor with Touch or Bolt. Refuses open edges, deep pits, protected ground and the Nether. One basin per paid cast.

name: Beacon Swell
description: Beacons within 16 blocks reach half again as far for 60 seconds.

name: Beastguard
description: Your pet, mount or a farm animal gets Resistance II and Fire Resistance for 60 seconds.

name: Beeline
description: You zip straight ahead like a bee to a flower, about 6 blocks, and land without a fall.

name: Bellward
description: For 2 minutes villagers within 12 blocks take 60% less damage from monsters, and monsters there glow.

name: Berrybless
description: Sweet berry bushes in a 5-by-5 patch ripen to full, and the glow berry vines among them come into fruit.

name: Black Ice
description: Freezes targets for 1.5 seconds (1 on players) and leaves them weak (Weakness II for 5 seconds). One that dies in the next 5 seconds shatters: 4 damage to enemies within 3 blocks, which turn brittle in their turn.

name: Blackflame
description: Black flames that water can't put out: 3 damage a second for 6 seconds. If the target dies burning, they spread.

name: Blackspark
description: 8 damage. One hit in four sparks black: 2.5x damage, an arc of 8 to the nearest other enemy, and you're in the zone (Strength and Speed) for 6 seconds.

name: Blastward
description: For 60 seconds explosions within 6 blocks break no blocks.

name: Blazecall
description: Three blaze fireballs fall on each target over a second: 3 fire damage each, setting it alight and staggering it.

name: Bleed
description: Opens a wound: 2 damage, then 1 more every half second for 4 seconds (half as much again while it moves).

name: Blind
description: Blindness and darkness for 5 seconds (3 on players). A blinded monster lashes out at whatever stands next to it.

name: Blink
description: Teleports you to where the spell landed (max 40 blocks).

name: Blizzard
description: A blizzard howls 3 blocks around where it lands for 4 seconds, walking 6 blocks the way you faced: enemies in it are slowed (Slowness II), chilled and take 1.5 damage a second.

name: Block Pack
description: Crafts nine of a kind in your pack into their block, like iron ingots into an iron block. 8 blocks at most.

name: Blood Escrow
description: Spend up to three actual health, never below four, to buy one ally a six-second absorption chamber. Crouching or an existing ward refuses. One gift per payment; no refund or renewal.

name: Blood Moss
description: Crimson moss spreads over each target: 1 damage a second for 6 seconds, and the most wounded of you and your allies nearby heals for all of it.

name: Blood Thread
description: Threads everything hit together (4 at most) for 8 seconds: 40% of any damage one of them takes is dealt to each of the rest (three times a second at most).

name: Bloodboil
description: 3 damage, and for 5 seconds the target's blood boils: each time it's hurt it takes 2 more fire damage (up to 5 times).

name: Bloom
description: Regeneration II for 6 seconds, plants grow around the first 3 allies it touches, and allies near them catch Regeneration I for 5.

name: Bloomstep
description: Steps you through a door of blossoms to where the spell landed (up to 32 blocks). Grass and flowers spring up where you left and where you arrive, and you and your allies within 3 blocks of where you arrive get Regeneration I for 5 seconds.

name: Bobber Bell
description: For 60 seconds your bobber rings and splashes when a fish bites.

name: Boiling Surge
description: Lifts nearby real water through a scalding arc, returning each source afterwards. Each enemy takes 5 damage once and two seconds of Weakness. Original steam curls trace the crest.

name: Bonespur
description: Spurs of bone burst from the ground under up to 4 enemies within 4 blocks: 5 damage each, and they bleed for 3 seconds.

name: Borrowed Time
description: Heals the damage you took in the last 5 seconds, as much as you're missing. Over the next 10 seconds it comes back with a fifth on top, but never kills you, unless you slay a monster.

name: Brace
description: Braces for the blow: 80% less damage for 2 seconds. Bracing again takes 6 seconds.

name: Bramble
description: Thorns for 10 seconds: the next 4 things that hurt you from within 4 blocks take 3 damage and are shoved away.

name: Break
description: Mines the block that was hit (up to iron-pickaxe hardness; Amplify for diamond).

name: Brickwork
description: Cuts stone near the point into its bricks. 9 at most.

name: Brimming
description: Fills up to 4 cauldrons within 4 blocks of the point with water.

name: Bubble
description: Traps targets in a floating bubble that pops for 4 damage and leaves them soaked. It holds small creatures 2.5 seconds, bigger ones 2, the largest 1.5.

name: Button Push
description: Presses up to 4 buttons near the point.

name: Calm Smoke
description: A puff of campfire smoke settles the angry bees within 6 blocks: they forget their quarrel and go back to work.

name: Camp Ward
description: Wards an 8-block camp for 5 minutes: monsters that appear inside fade at once, and phantoms nearby lose their prey. One per caster.

name: Caveward
description: For 60 seconds, sand, gravel or powder snow that buries the target's head crumbles into items.

name: Dust Line
description: Draws a dust line from you to the point for 10 seconds and tells its length in blocks.

name: Chalk Line
description: Draws a line from you to the point for 20 seconds and tells you its length and rise.

name: Checker Dye
description: Like Dye Wash, but only every other block, for a checkered pattern. One dye per 8 blocks.

name: Chest Sort
description: Joins like items in the chest, barrel or shulker box hit and lays them out in order.

name: Chill
description: Slowness II for 6 seconds and 1 freeze damage. Chill again within 6 seconds and the cold deepens (III, then IV).

name: Chisel
description: Mines the block that was hit (up to stone-pickaxe hardness; Amplify for iron).

name: Chronoshift
description: Turns an ally's clock forward: their other spells come off cooldown 3 seconds sooner, a third of the mana they spent in the last 5 seconds comes back (30 at most), and they get Haste I and Speed I for 5 seconds.

name: Cinder Bulwark
description: Raises a cracked, glowing wall. Enemies brushing against it take 2 magic damage once per cast. Lasts eight seconds and drops nothing.

name: Cinder Sieve
description: Consumes one carried coal or charcoal to furnace-process up to sixteen visible loose inputs within four blocks. Only commits when complete outputs fit your inventory. Preserves owned, delayed and protected drops; grants no XP. Once per paid cast.

name: Cinderbrand
description: Brands each target: 3 fire damage, and for 6 seconds your fire spells burn it 50% hotter and its burning hurts a little more.

name: Cinderheart
description: Your heart burns for 12 seconds: Strength II, fire can't hurt you, and every enemy within 4 blocks takes 3 fire damage a second. It can't be lit again until 24 seconds after it goes out.

name: Citadel
description: An 8-block ward for 60 seconds: explosions break nothing, missiles from outside drop at the edge, and allies inside take 20% less damage.

name: Cleanse
description: Washes away harmful effects, fire and every elemental mark.

name: Cleave
description: Cuts in proportion to the target: 6 damage plus 10% of its max health (up to 20 more); enemies beside it take half (three at most).

name: Cloche
description: Sets a glass of quickened time over a 5-by-5 patch for 30 seconds: once a second, every plant under it gets the growing tick the world gives now and then. At most 25 plants a second.

name: Clockroot
description: Roots remember safe ground for four seconds. A foe fleeing more than two blocks is returned once if its original floor and route are still safe, loaded and permitted. Refuses bosses, anchored or mounted targets and warded arenas. At most eight foes per paid cast; eight-second target rest.

name: Clot
description: For 3 minutes, poison and wither on you wear off twice as fast.

name: Coldsnap
description: A cold snap racing out from the point: 4 freeze damage and Slowness II for 4 seconds to every enemy within 3 blocks, all left brittle for Shatter for 4 seconds.

name: Collect
description: Pulls up to 48 items and experience within 8 blocks from ground you can edit. Other owners' drops and pickup reservations stay put.

name: Cometfall
description: A comet streaks down on the point a second later: 16 damage to every enemy within 4 blocks, setting them alight, and five shards of it scatter into the nearest other enemies within 10 blocks for 4 each. Never breaks blocks.

name: Compost
description: Feeds the composter you strike from your inventory, as if you dropped the items in yourself: up to 8 seeds, leaves or scraps (16 at double power).

name: Concrete Set
description: Concrete powder near the point sets into concrete. 16 at most.

name: Conflagration
description: Sets targets alight for 6 seconds, and every burning enemy within 6 blocks flares up for 4 damage (1 more for each other one flaring, up to 3) and burns 2 seconds longer.

name: Coppice
description: Fells the tree you strike (its logs, never more than 32, drop as an axe would cut them) and replants the stump with a sapling from your inventory. A log with no living leaves is part of a build and is left alone.

name: Coral Mend
description: Dead coral touching water within 3 blocks of the point comes back to life, up to 8.

name: Corral
description: Enemies within 5 blocks are kept inside the ring for 6 seconds.

name: Countdown
description: Marks targets: 1.5 seconds later the moment catches up with them for 6 damage. If the mark dies first, it finds the nearest enemy within 6 blocks.

name: Courtship
description: Up to 6 grown farm animals within 5 blocks fall in love at once, as if you'd fed them. Animals that aren't ready yet (or belong to someone else) are left alone.

name: Crimson Mist
description: A red mist 3 blocks around where it lands for 5 seconds: enemies in it bleed for 2 damage a second, allies in it heal 1.5 health a second and are hidden from monsters more than 4 blocks away.

name: Cryostasis
description: Seals an ally in ice for 2 seconds (4 at most, however it's extended): they can't move, cast or be hurt, and heal 6 health while they wait. When it opens it bursts: enemies within 3 blocks are thrown back, take 3, and are slowed and left brittle. Not again on the same creature for 10 seconds.

name: Current
description: Only in water or rain: a current sweeps you and the allies within 2 blocks about 15 blocks the way you look, and you land without fall damage. On dry land it fizzles.

name: Currentkin
description: Swim with the dolphins' grace for 3 minutes. Can be a passive.

name: Cushion
description: For 30 seconds falls can't hurt you, and a hard landing throws out a gust that knocks enemies back and hurts them: three quarters of a point for every block you fell past four (6 at most).

name: Cyclone
description: A whirlwind spins every enemy within 3 blocks around the point for 2 seconds, then flings them all the way you were facing for 3 damage.

name: Dash
description: Shoves targets the way you're facing. On Self it's a precise dash of about ten blocks: level, and it stops where it should.

name: Decree
description: A spoken command: everything hit is stunned for 2 seconds and condemned: your next 2 spell hits on it deal 40% more. Speaking it costs you 2 health, unless it holds 3 or more.

name: Deepsound
description: Tells you the nearest ore up to 16 blocks under the point, and how deep.

name: Deepwarn
description: For 5 minutes, warns you of lava below or a long drop ahead. Can be a passive.

name: Deepway
description: Bores a 3x3 road 3 deep into the wall hit (diamond-pickaxe hardness) and sets 2 torches from your pack.

name: Deflect
description: For 8 seconds a whirl of wind sends arrows and other projectiles coming at the target back at whoever shot them.

name: Delvemark
description: Marks your spot for 10 minutes. Cast again within 128 blocks and hold still 2 seconds to go back to it.

name: Depth Sounding
description: Sounds the rock under the point: how far down the first open cave or lava lies, up to 64 blocks.

name: Devour
description: 5 damage, and 1 more for every tenth of its health the target is missing (up to 10). If it kills, you feed: 10 mana and 4 absorption (twice a cast at most).

name: Dew Drink
description: For 10 minutes, rain or water feeds you a hunger point every 15 seconds.

name: Dewcatch
description: Up to 4 glass bottles in your pack fill with water.

name: Dewfall
description: A soft dew wets every farmland block in a 5-by-5 patch around the point to full moisture.

name: Dewkeep
description: Hangs a mist over a 5-by-5 patch for 60 seconds: its farmland is wetted now and again every 5 seconds, so a field far from water never dries. Lovely from a Totem or a Zone.

name: Disarm
description: A snatching gust tears the weapon from each creature's hand for 5 seconds, then it drifts back. Bosses keep hold; a player keeps hold too, but can't use what they're holding for 3 seconds.

name: Dismantle
description: Three unseen slashes a tenth of a second apart: 3 damage each, straight through armour; the last is twice as deep against something that isn't facing you.

name: Ditchwater
description: Fills the hole you strike with one source of water, if it is an open hole with farmland within 4 blocks. Never in the Nether's heat.

name: Diver's Hands
description: Mine at full speed under water for 60 seconds.

name: Diving Bell
description: Under water: a 1-by-2 pocket of air at the point, walled in glass, for 15 seconds.

name: Dolphin Call
description: Dolphins within 24 blocks swim to you. If any come, you get Dolphin's Grace for 20 seconds.

name: Doomclock
description: Sets a clock ticking on each target (3 at most) for 3 seconds: every blow it takes meanwhile (up to four a second) winds it 2 tighter, 12 at most. At zero it bursts: 8 damage and all it was wound, to it and every enemy within 3 blocks (an enemy takes one burst a cast). Never breaks blocks.

name: Doorcall
description: Opens or shuts up to 4 doors, trapdoors and gates near the point. Iron ones stay put.

name: Downdraft
description: Slams every airborne enemy within 6 blocks to the ground: 4 damage, and 1 more for every block it fell (up to 6). Flyers lose their lift. With nothing in the air it pins whoever stands under it (Slowness III for a second, 2 damage).

name: Dragon Breath
description: A 3-block cloud that rolls on along the way you blew it: 5 damage per second for 5 seconds.

name: Drift Net
description: Up to 16 items floating in water within 6 blocks of the point drift to you. Others' drops stay put.

name: Drown Ward
description: For 60 seconds your air refills when it runs low, up to 3 times.

name: Drowning Word
description: A drowning word: for 5 seconds the target's lungs fill with water (it loses its air, takes 2 damage a second and can't cast), and it's soaked.

name: Drowse
description: Sleepy pollen lulls each target to sleep for 6 seconds (2 on players): it can't move or fight back, but any damage wakes it, and the blow that does deals 75% more. Bosses only grow drowsy.

name: Dust Devil
description: A dust devil touches down where it lands and chases the nearest enemy for 5 seconds. Enemies within 2 blocks of it are caught up and whirled round it, blinded and scoured for 3 damage a second; when it blows out it flings them high.

name: Dye Wash
description: Recolours up to 16 wool, glass, terracotta, concrete or candle blocks around the point to the dye in your other hand. One dye per 8 blocks.

name: Dynamo Stride
description: For 5 minutes, every 24 blocks you walk gives back 2 mana, up to 12.

name: Echolocate
description: A sonar pulse from the point: every enemy within 16 blocks glows through walls for 10 seconds, and those it hits are dazed (Slowness II) for 3.

name: Eclipse
description: A dark disc eclipses the point for 5 seconds: enemies beneath it (4 blocks) are blinded, take 2 damage a second, and your spells hit them 20% harder. Under it the light counts as dim.

name: Ember
description: 3 fire damage and sets alight for 3 seconds. On something already burning it adds 3 seconds instead (10 at most).

name: Ember Rest
description: Kindles a resting fire for 5 minutes: allies within 6 blocks regenerate and stay warm. One per caster.

name: Emberguard
description: Puts the target out and gives Fire Resistance for 30 seconds.

name: Empower
description: Strength II for 10 seconds, then Weakness I for 4 (a passive carries only Strength I).

name: Enderhush
description: For 10 minutes, endermen you haven't hurt forget their anger at you. Can be a passive.

name: Entropy
description: The target unravels: 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5 and 3 damage over 5 seconds, straight through armour, and each wound strips a point of its armour until it ends.

name: Evade
description: For 10 seconds the next melee blow misses and the target slips aside.

name: Everburn
description: Sets targets alight for 5 seconds with a fire that burns two and a half times as fast (1.5 more damage a second), and rekindles once for 3 more when it goes out.

name: Excavate
description: Mines a 3x3 area of blocks (up to iron-pickaxe hardness; Amplify for diamond).

name: Explode
description: 12 damage in a 3.5-block blast that throws what it hits. Blasts of one cast never stack on one enemy. Never breaks blocks.

name: Fair Wind
description: In a boat: sail the way you look for 10 seconds.

name: Faithful
description: For 5 minutes, a killing blow leaves your pet at 1 health beside you. Once per 10 minutes each.

name: Fallow
description: Rests the bare farmland in a 5-by-5 patch back into dirt. Farmland with something growing on it is left as it is.

name: Fangs
description: A ring of evoker fangs snaps up around each target: 6 damage from below.

name: Fathom
description: Tells how deep the water is at the point and marks the bottom.

name: Feast Day
description: A harvest feast for everyone it reaches: 6 hunger and 6 seconds of Saturation each, and Regeneration I for 10 seconds.

name: Feather Fall
description: Slow falling and no fall damage for 12 seconds, and you drift the way you look while you fall (sneak to stop).

name: Fell
description: Fells the tree that was hit: the log and every log joined to it above, up to 32.

name: Field Sense
description: Reads the field within 6 blocks: every ripe crop glints, and you're told how many are ripe and how many are still growing.

name: Fieldstride
description: A farmhand's long stride: Speed I and Jump Boost I for 20 seconds.

name: Fire
description: 5 fire damage and sets alight for 6 seconds.

name: Firebreak
description: Puts out fire within 5 blocks, and the allies there.

name: Firestorm
description: Sets targets alight for 6 seconds and deals 5 damage, and the fire leaps to every enemy within 2 blocks of them (2 damage), then a moment later to those within 2 blocks of those (1.5).

name: Fireward
description: Fire resistance for 30 seconds.

name: Flash Freeze
description: 4 freeze damage. A soaked target (in water, or after a water rune or Bubble) freezes solid for 3 seconds (1.5 on players), one only rained on for 2 (1); a dry one is slowed and left brittle.

name: Flashfire
description: A flash of heat: 5 fire damage to every enemy within 3 blocks, setting them alight for 4 seconds. Allies in it are thawed and dried.

name: Fleece
description: Shears every woolly sheep within 5 blocks, as shears would, and the wool falls at their feet.

name: Floorlay
description: Lays a 5x5 floor at the point from stone, dirt or planks in your pack, over air only.

name: Fodder
description: Feeds the animals within 5 blocks from your inventory, each with one item of the food it eats: it heals 4 and a young one grows a tenth of the way up.

name: Folk Call
description: Villagers within 16 blocks walk over to the point.

name: Folk Census
description: Counts the villagers within 32 blocks: with a trade, without one, nitwits, children, and golems.

name: Foresight
description: Sees the next 2 attacks coming (for 15 seconds): each is dodged with a sidestep. A dodge turns away 12 damage at most, and casting it again in the same spell doesn't refill it.

name: Fortress Sense
description: In the Nether, senses the nearest fortress and tells which way and roughly how far. Structure senses share a 30-second rest.

name: Fortune
description: For 10 seconds, every hit you deal has a 1 in 4 chance to strike for double, and a kill has a 1 in 4 chance to drop extra experience.

name: Fossilize
description: The target turns slowly to stone: Slowness I, II, then III over 3 seconds, then it's stone, held for 2 seconds (1 on players), brittle while it stands (every spell hits it 20% harder), and cracked for 6 damage.

name: Frame Veil
description: Item frames holding an item within 6 blocks turn invisible. Cast again to show them.

name: Freeze
description: Freezes targets solid for 2.5 seconds: they can't move or fight back.

name: Frost
description: 5 freeze damage and Slowness III for 4 seconds; the frost leaves it brittle for Shatter for 4 seconds.

name: Frost Molt
description: Peel an actual frozen condition into one three-second ice plate. It stops one ordinary projectile of six damage or less; larger, bypass and other attacks pass. Clean allies cannot mint a plate; crouching sheds it.

name: Frostbite
description: 3 damage, then 1 damage a second for 5 seconds as the cold sets in (Slowness I, then II, then III); at the end the target freezes for a second and a half.

name: Frostbloom
description: Regeneration II for 5 seconds, and for 8 seconds anything that strikes the ally is frozen stiff (Slowness III for 2 seconds) and heals them a point (4 at most).

name: Frostward
description: For 60 seconds you can't freeze, not even in powder snow, and a frost hold on you lasts a second at most.

name: Frostwire
description: Chills each target (Slowness II for 4 seconds); a moment later a current races through every chilled or frozen enemy within 6 blocks of it, 6 at most: 5 damage each, 7 to one frozen solid.

name: Gale Mantle
description: For 12 seconds, jump again in midair to dash the way you're steering (up to 3 dashes), shoving aside whoever you pass.

name: Galvanize
description: Sets a spark of raw power against the block it strikes for 5 seconds: it powers what it touches as a redstone block would (doors open, lamps light, pistons push).

name: Gangue
description: Mines plain rock within 2 blocks of the point and leaves the ores standing.

name: Gash
description: A wound that won't close: 3 damage, and for 8 seconds the target can't heal, is left bleeding, and weeps 0.4 damage plus 1% of its health a second.

name: Gentle Hand
description: Farm animals within 5 blocks stop panicking and stand calm for 8 seconds, easy to lead or pen.

name: Geode
description: Crystal armour: Resistance II for 5 seconds, and anything that strikes the ally is cut by crystal shards for 2 damage and left cracked (every spell hits it 20% harder for 5 seconds).

name: Glacier
description: Freezes targets in place for 2 seconds (1 second on players). The ice spreads: up to 3 other enemies within 2.5 blocks freeze for 1 second, and when it cracks everything frozen takes 2.

name: Glidewind
description: For 2 minutes, a tailwind keeps your elytra glide from slowing down, up to a steady cruise.

name: Glimmer
description: Grows glowing lichen over the block that was hit and up to 4 around it: a light that stays.

name: Gloomsight
description: Marks the pitch-dark floor near the point, where monsters spawn, for 10 seconds.

name: Glowvine
description: Glowing cave vines heavy with glow berries grow down from the ceiling around the point: a light that stays. Vines already there bear berries again.

name: Glyph Carve
description: Carves a glowing glyph of the way you face onto the first blank line of a sign.

name: Gold Parley
description: Piglins within 12 blocks forget their anger at you. Brutes stay angry.

name: Gourdcall
description: Grown pumpkin and melon stems in a 5-by-5 patch try at once to set their fruit, as many times as a day of waiting would give them.

name: Grace
description: For 60 seconds a killing blow leaves the target at 2 health with Resistance III for 3 seconds. Once per 10 minutes each; never a boss.

name: Grapple
description: Pulls you to where the spell hit, and stops you there.

name: Grave Bearing
description: Tells which way you last died and roughly how far, when it was in this world.

name: Gravefinder
description: For a minute, pale motes point the way to where you last died.

name: Gravity Well
description: Drags every enemy within 7 blocks into the point for 2 seconds and pulls what hovers over it down; they're left pulled.

name: Grow
description: Bone-meals the block that was hit and everything around it, and young animals there grow up.

name: Guardlink
description: For 15 seconds, 40% of the ally's damage comes to you instead. Breaks past 16 blocks or at 6 health. Not on yourself.

name: Haggle
description: For 20 seconds villagers give you their Hero of the Village prices.

name: Hail
description: Five hailstones of 2 damage each, each staggering the target, and Slowness II for 4 seconds.

name: Halo
description: A halo crowns the ally for 8 seconds: every 1.5 seconds it smites an enemy within 6 blocks of them (whoever hurt them, or else the nearest) for 3 holy damage (tripled against undead), and the ally heals 1 each time.

name: Harm
description: 7 magic damage, and it leaves the target exposed for 3 seconds (an arcane mark: Unweave and Prismatic Burst count it).

name: Harvest
description: Harvests grown crops around the block hit, and replants them.

name: Haste
description: Haste II for 30 seconds: mine and swing faster, and a charged cast fills 30% sooner.

name: Haven
description: Raises living leaf shutters across a 4-block haven for 8 seconds: enemies inside are shoved out once a second, and enemy projectiles glance off its boundary.

name: Hayloft
description: Tosses you up as if from a haystack, about 4 blocks, and you float down for 3 seconds without a fall.

name: Headlamp
description: A light follows the target for 60 seconds.

name: Heal
description: Restores 8 health (4 hearts; repeats within one cast heal less). What the target can't use becomes a shield of up to 2 hearts for 10 seconds.

name: Hearthbond
description: Bonds you and allies within 12 blocks for 3 minutes: when one drops low they regenerate, and the rest hear it. Once a minute each.

name: Hearthcook
description: Cooks the raw food in your own inventory as a smoker would: up to 8 pieces (16 at double power). Only food; the rest of your pack is left alone.

name: Hearthglow
description: A 4-block glow for 12 seconds: allies inside are thawed and kept at Regeneration I.

name: Hearthguard
description: A villager, trader or golem takes 60% less damage from monsters for 5 minutes.

name: Hearthpath
description: For a minute, warm motes point the way to your bed or spawn.

name: Hearthsong
description: Heals each ally within 6 blocks for 2, plus 1 for every ally there (up to 6).

name: Heartsense
description: For 30 seconds, you see the heartbeat of every creature within 24 blocks.

name: Heartstopper
description: 5 damage, and for 6 seconds the target's heart skips every 2 seconds: a stumble, a lurch, then a full stop (a quarter, half, then one and a half seconds of stun).

name: Heel
description: Your pets within 32 blocks that are not sitting come to your side.

name: Hellmouth
description: Opens a pit of black fire for 3 seconds that drags enemies within 3 blocks toward it and burns those at its core for 2 damage a second, then caves in for 4 damage.

name: Hemomancy
description: 4 magic damage, and 1 more for every 1.5 health you're missing (up to 8 more). Under half health you heal a quarter of what it deals.

name: Henhouse
description: Each chicken within 5 blocks lays its next egg now. A hen hurried along can't be hurried again for 2 minutes.

name: Herdcall
description: Farm animals within 8 blocks walk to the spot it lands (to you, cast on yourself). Up to 12 come at once.

name: Herdsense
description: Farm animals within 12 blocks glow for 10 seconds, and you're told how many there are and how many are ready to breed.

name: Hex
description: Hexes targets for 6 seconds: your spells hit them 25% harder, and they fix on you.

name: Hexguard
description: For 20 seconds, the next harmful effect that would land is refused.

name: Hive Hum
description: Each beehive and bee nest within 5 blocks fills by one level of honey. A hive hummed into can't be hurried again for a minute.

name: Hoarfrost
description: Rime creeps over each target for 3 seconds, slowing it more every second; then it freezes solid for 2 seconds and takes 6 damage, and the frost blooms: enemies within 2 blocks take 3 and are slowed. Cast again on a creeping target, it starts nothing new.

name: Hobble
description: Slowness III for 4 seconds. No harm.

name: Holefill
description: Fills holes near the point up to its height with stone, dirt or planks from your pack. 16 at most.

name: Hollow
description: Erases what it hits: it vanishes for a moment and returns for 20 damage, and everything within 4 blocks is dragged into the gap for 8 more.

name: Hollow Pocket
description: Opens your own 9-slot pocket. What you keep there stays yours, through death too.

name: Hollow Sense
description: Points you to the nearest open cave within 12 blocks of the point.

name: Home Bearing
description: Tells which way your bed or respawn anchor lies and roughly how far, when it is in this world.

name: Homeward
description: Hold still for 3 seconds to return to your lodestar, in this world and within 2000 blocks. Moving or getting hurt breaks it. 2-minute rest.

name: Honeydew
description: Sweet as a honey bottle: cures Poison and heals 3 (more with power).

name: Hush
description: A pocket of silence at the point for 6 seconds (4 blocks): monsters inside lose their targets and are weakened, and enemy casters can't cast.

name: Ice Auger
description: Bores through up to 3 blocks of ice at the point, leaving water to fish in.

name: Icepath
description: Freezes water within 3 blocks into ice you can walk on. On Self it lays a strip of ice ten blocks long the way you look.

name: Icicle
description: 4 freeze damage, or 6 against a target that's already slowed. The icicle melts after 2 seconds and leaves it soaked.

name: Inferno
description: Everything within 4 blocks burns: 3 fire damage a second for 4 seconds.

name: Infest
description: Silverfish burrow out of the stone around each target: 1 damage every half second for 4 seconds, and Slowness I.

name: Infinity
description: For 6 seconds the closer a hostile thing comes the slower it moves: enemies within 5 blocks are slowed harder the nearer they are, and projectiles slow to a stop in the air.

name: Inkveil
description: Invisible for 10 seconds in water, 3 on land.

name: Ironhold
description: For 6 seconds no single blow deals the target more than 4.

name: Jolt
description: 4 lightning damage that stuns for 1 second: no moving or fighting back. A caster caught mid-charge loses the spell.

name: Keenkeep
description: Your held tool wears half as fast for 5 minutes. Can be a passive.

name: Keepsafe
description: For 10 minutes the block hit can't be broken by anyone outside your party, nor by explosions.

name: Kelpsong
description: Kelp, seagrass and sea pickles within 4 blocks of the point grow as if bone mealed, up to 8.

name: Kiln Bake
description: Blocks near the point bake in place when a furnace makes a block of them, like sand to glass. 9 at most.

name: Kindling
description: 3 fire damage and a stack of Kindling. The fifth stack ignites: 14 damage in a 3-block burst, and everything the burst reaches starts at two stacks.

name: Lamplighter
description: Lights the unlit candles and campfires within 6 blocks.

name: Land Reading
description: Reads the ground where it lands: its biome, how warm it is, and its height against sea level.

name: Landread
description: Tells you the biome, height and light where it lands, and whether slimes spawn there.

name: Lantern Soul
description: An unseen light follows you for 5 minutes. Can be a passive.

name: Lapis Thrift
description: For 60 seconds, your next enchantment at a table gives one lapis back.

name: Last Lantern
description: Record one allied player's safe ground for six seconds. Their next fresh crouch requests one safe return within eight blocks. Invalid floor, route, dimension or permission refuses. No health rewind or forced return.

name: Launch
description: Flings targets high into the air, where every spell hits them harder. On Self it rockets you up and forward.

name: Lava Crust
description: The lava top around the point hardens to basalt for 20 seconds, a safe place to land.

name: Lava Sense
description: Tells how much lava lies within 8 blocks and which way the nearest is.

name: Lava Seal
description: Lava within 3 blocks of the point sets: still lava to obsidian, flowing lava to cobblestone. 16 at most.

name: Leaffall
description: The wild leaves in a 5-by-5-by-5 block around the point drop now, as if they'd decayed, with what decay would drop. Leaves placed by hand stay.

name: Leafshade
description: Cool leaf-shade: Fire Resistance for 15 seconds.

name: Leap
description: Jump Boost III for 15 seconds.

name: Leech
description: 3 damage, and you heal for what it takes; what a full heart can't hold becomes a shield of up to 4.

name: Levelground
description: Mines away what stands up to 3 blocks over the point within 2 blocks of it.

name: Lever Flip
description: Flips up to 4 levers near the point.

name: Levitate
description: Targets hang in the air for 3 seconds, their drift stopped, and every spell hits them harder while they're off the ground. On Self you float.

name: Lifebloom
description: Heals 4, then 1 a second for 5 seconds; when it fades it bursts, healing every ally within 3 blocks for 3.

name: Lifesteal
description: 5 damage, and you heal for what it dealt. For 6 seconds everything the target suffers, from anyone, heals you for a quarter of it.

name: Light
description: A light source at the point for 60 seconds.

name: Lightning
description: A 12-damage lightning strike on each target that slows and burns. An enemy takes the strongest strike of a cast once, however many land beside it. You and your allies are immune.

name: Lily Path
description: Lays up to 10 lily pads across the water the way you look, for 30 seconds.

name: Lodepull
description: Loose drops within 6 blocks drift to the target for 30 seconds. Never someone else's drops.

name: Lodestar
description: Sets your lodestar where it lands, or at your feet. Homeward takes you back to it.

name: Long Arm
description: Reach 2 blocks farther to build and mine for 5 minutes. Can be a passive.

name: Lore Reading
description: Reads the item in your hand: how many enchantments it holds and what an anvil will charge to work it.

name: Lostfind
description: For 30 seconds, gold motes point to the nearest loose items within 32 blocks.

name: Luckcharm
description: Luck I for 5 minutes. Can be a passive.

name: Luckstrike
description: Mines the ore hit with Fortune I (II with Amplify).

name: Lullaby
description: You and allies within 8 blocks count as rested, so phantoms leave you be. Tells you how many are asleep.

name: Lumen Path
description: Hangs a light every 4 blocks from you to the point, 6 at most, for 120 seconds.

name: Lure
description: Enemies drop their target and walk to where it lands for 4 seconds.

name: Lux Reading
description: Reads the light where it lands, from blocks and from the sky, and whether monsters may spawn there.

name: Magma
description: The ground under the target turns to magma for 4 seconds: 2 damage a second to every enemy standing on it, and the pool widens as it burns.

name: Magnetize
description: Magnetizes a target for 4 seconds: enemies within 5 blocks are drawn to it, and any that touch it are shocked for 3 damage (once a second).

name: Malison
description: 4 damage and a curse for 8 seconds: your spells hit it 25% harder, and it's shadowed. If it dies cursed, the curse passes on, 5% stronger each time (up to 45%), for the time it had left, to up to 3 enemies within 6 blocks of it.

name: Manabraid
description: Offers an allied connected caster a three-second mana gift. They must release and freshly crouch to accept. After the spell price, spends at most twenty-four extra mana to restore at most sixteen, keeping two. Donor rests thirty seconds; receiver ten.

name: Manaburn
description: Burns magic: 5 damage. A spellcaster (a player wearing a Cord, or a Runebound) also takes 4 more, a player loses up to 20 mana (less from a weaker hit), and a charge or telegraphed cast in hand is cut short.

name: Managift
description: Gives up to 20 of your mana to each ally player hit; they get three quarters of it. Never yourself.

name: Manatide
description: Drinks in the storm: for 10 seconds, every spell you and your allies hit cast gives back a quarter of its mana (30 at most, however extended). Each player can drink only once a minute.

name: Manawell
description: A 3-block well for 10 seconds: allies inside regain 2 mana each second.

name: Mending Mist
description: A 4-block mist for 8 seconds: allies inside heal 1 each second.

name: Meteor
description: A burning meteor falls on each target (two at most) 1.2 seconds later: 12 damage in a 3.5-block blast, and the crater burns on for a moment.

name: Milkmaid
description: Fills the empty buckets in your inventory with milk, one for each grown cow or goat within 5 blocks.

name: Millstone
description: Grinds up to 16 cobblestone in your pack into gravel, or else gravel into sand.

name: Mire
description: The ground turns to mire under each target for 5 seconds: it sinks (Slowness IV, no jumping) and is soaked.

name: Mirrorfrost
description: Casts back the last spell that hit you in the past 30 seconds, as your own at 70% power. A spell cast back can't be cast back again.

name: Monolith
description: A pillar of stone bursts up under the target: 8 damage, and it's thrown 3 blocks into the air; where it lands, 3 more to whatever is there. The pillar crumbles after 4 seconds.

name: Moon Reading
description: Reads the moon tonight and how many nights until the next full moon.

name: Moonpetal
description: A storm of moonlit petals at the point: 5 damage to every enemy within 3 blocks, and 4 health to you and your allies there. Stronger under a full moon and at night, weaker under a new moon.

name: Mooring Call
description: The nearest empty boat within 24 blocks comes to your side.

name: Morale
description: Allies within 6 blocks get Absorption for 20 seconds, one level for each ally there (up to III).

name: Motherlode
description: Mines up to 16 ores within 3 blocks of the point with Fortune II (III with Amplify).

name: Nest Tend
description: Turtle eggs within 4 blocks move a stage closer to hatching, up to 4, and baby turtles grow.

name: Night Eye
description: Night vision for 60 seconds.

name: Night Seam
description: Inspect beyond at most three owned ordinary stone cells for one open-ground and nearby-threat clue. No blocks change, no one moves, and protected, special, block-entity, warded or unloaded walls refuse.

name: Nightwatch
description: For 10 minutes, a bell warns you when a monster within 16 blocks starts hunting you. Can be a passive.

name: Nourish
description: Restores 6 hunger and some saturation, and ends Hunger. Fed pets heal 6 and are ready to breed.

name: Nudge
description: A gentle push 3 blocks away from you. No harm.

name: Nullcatch
description: An open mirror pocket catches one hostile front projectile over three seconds. One payment buys one capture; rear, allied, reflected and ownerless attacks pass. No stored attack or refund.

name: Nullify
description: Strips an enemy's good effects, or an ally's bad effects. Vexes, and spirit wolves and shades that aren't yours, dissolve.

name: Ocean's Favor
description: Water Breathing, Dolphin's Grace, Conduit Power and Night Vision for 120 seconds. Found only, never crafted.

name: Orbcall
description: Experience orbs within 10 blocks drift to you for 5 minutes. Can be a passive.

name: Ore Pluck
description: Mines up to 8 ores with an open face within 4 blocks of the point.

name: Ore Tally
description: Counts the ores within 6 blocks of the point by kind.

name: Overdrive
description: Past your limits for 10 seconds: Strength II, Speed II and Haste II, but you lose 1 health every 2 seconds. The weaker it leaves you, the harder you hit: Strength III under half health, IV under a quarter.

name: Pacify
description: The creature forgets its target and picks none for 6 seconds; harming it ends this. Players get Weakness instead. Not bosses.

name: Pack Tidy
description: Joins like stacks in your pack. Your hotbar is left alone.

name: Parasite
description: Plants a parasite in each target for 6 seconds: Poison I, and every second it drains 1 health from it into you. If its host dies with it inside, it leaps to the nearest enemy within 6 blocks for the time it had left (once).

name: Pearl Sight
description: Conduit Power for 30 seconds.

name: Pelt
description: Pelts targets with stones: 4 damage and a hard shove.

name: Petward
description: Your pets within 16 blocks get Resistance I for 3 minutes.

name: Phantom
description: Leaves an afterimage of you that every monster within 16 blocks turns on for 4 seconds, then it bursts for 8 damage, and 1 more for every 6 it took.

name: Phoenix Pyre
description: Wreathes allies in healing flame for 6 seconds: Regeneration I and Fire Resistance, and every second enemies within 2 blocks of them are set alight and take 1 damage. The first time an ally falls under 35% health the pyre flares: 6 health, and 4 damage to enemies within 3 blocks.

name: Picnic
description: A shared basket: each target eats 3 hunger and heals 2 (more with power).

name: Pit Floor
description: Lays a 3x3 packed mud floor over the air at the point. It crumbles after 20 seconds.

name: Plankway
description: Lays a lasting bridge up to 12 long the way you face, from planks or stone in your pack.

name: Plasma
description: 10 damage, half of it ignoring armour, and the target is ionised for 5 seconds: the next storm damage it takes conducts as if it were wet.

name: Plowline
description: Ploughs a straight furrow from the block it strikes along the way you face: up to 8 blocks of dirt or grass tilled into farmland, longer with power (16 at most).

name: Plumb Line
description: Digs a shaft up to 8 deep under the point (iron-pickaxe hardness). Stops a block above lava, water or a drop.

name: Pocket Current
description: Water envelopes carry up to sixteen ready, permitted loose items into your own tracked chest. Both halves need ownership and permission; full slots, foreign drops, locks and loot tables refuse without item loss.

name: Polish
description: Polishes stone near the point: andesite, granite, diorite, tuff, basalt and the like. 9 at most.

name: Pollinate
description: The bees within 8 blocks dust the crops around the point: one crop in a 5-by-5 patch grows a stage for each bee, 2 per bee at double power. No bees, no help.

name: Porpoise Leap
description: In water: leap forward like a dolphin, with no fall damage from the leap.

name: Portal Reckoning
description: Tells where this spot lies in the other realm: one Nether block is eight in the Overworld.

name: Portal Sense
description: Senses the nearest ruined portal and tells which way and roughly how far. Structure senses share a 30-second rest.

name: Portalfall
description: A portal opens under each target and drops it from up to 7 blocks up, with 2 damage on the way through; where it lands, enemies within 2 blocks take 3 and stagger.

name: Potion Steep
description: Good potion effects last a quarter longer, up to 45 seconds more and 8 minutes in all.

name: Primer
description: Turns each target into a bomb that goes off 2 seconds later, or the moment it dies: 10 damage within 3 blocks (an enemy takes only the strongest bomb). Never breaks blocks.

name: Prismatic Burst
description: 5 damage, and 4 more for every mark on the target (burning, frozen, windswept, pulled, soaked, wet, cracked, shadowed, bleeding or exposed), up to 5, each used up and passed on to up to 3 enemies within 4 blocks: up to 25.

name: Prolong
description: Every good effect on the target (Speed, Strength, Regeneration, a potion's...) lasts 15 seconds longer, up to 5 minutes.

name: Prospect
description: The ground rings out: every ore within 12 blocks of where it lands glows through the rock for 20 seconds.

name: Prune
description: A gust clears leaves, grass, flowers, vines and cobwebs within 3 blocks, and they drop as they would to shears.

name: Pull
description: Pulls targets toward the spell, leaving them staggered and marked as pulled for 4 seconds.

name: Pulse Ferry
description: One sap parcel visits two different wounded eligible allies within four blocks on separate beats. Each receives at most three actual healing, six total. Crouching refuses a visit. No overheal or repeated recovery.

name: Push
description: Hurls targets away from the spell.

name: Quench
description: Puts you out, and for 3 minutes fire on you burns out three times as fast.

name: Quickbrew
description: Brewing stands within 6 blocks brew twice as fast for 20 seconds.

name: Quietus
description: A visible short escrow waits for one newly cast hostile magic projectile, closes on it and taxes up to eight of its player's current mana. No hit, free ammunition or mana reward; old and reflected spells pass.

name: Raincloud
description: A small cloud rains on the point: farmland within 4 blocks is soaked, up to 8 crops grow, fires go out and a cauldron gains water.

name: Rally
description: Allies within 8 blocks get Speed I and Jump Boost I for 12 seconds.

name: Rally Light
description: Raises a beacon for 3 minutes: allies within 10 blocks get Haste I and Speed I. One per caster.

name: Rampart
description: Raises a 5-wide, 3-high wall of earth at the point for 10 seconds.

name: Razorgale
description: A whirl of blades round where it lands: every enemy within 3 blocks is cut for 2 and left bleeding; half a second later the gale comes back round for 2 more, tearing every wound open (Rupture).

name: Reckoning
description: For 4 seconds, every wound the target takes is counted; then half of it comes due again at once (at most 12), and half of what comes due heals you (at most 6).

name: Recoil
description: Hurls targets 5 blocks back; 2 seconds later the wind snaps them back to where they stood, for 5 damage.

name: Red Ledger
description: Three visible blood gates measure ordinary movement over three seconds. Moving one block spends a gate for a small cut. Standing still avoids all cuts; teleports do not count. Six total damage per payment after bonuses.

name: Reed Cut
description: Cuts kelp, seagrass, sugar cane and lily pads within 3 blocks of the point, up to 12. Kelp and cane keep their base to regrow.

name: Reeling Tide
description: Reels in your bobber with the rod in your hand. A fish that is biting is caught as usual.

name: Reflect
description: For 10 seconds, whatever hurts the target takes 60% of the damage back as arcane damage that ignores armour. Each reflection cracks it (6 at most).

name: Refloat
description: Fish, squid and dolphins stranded on land within 6 blocks are set back in water within 8 blocks.

name: Regrowth
description: Regeneration that takes hold: I for 3 seconds, II for 3, III for 2 (about 7 health).

name: Relic Sense
description: Suspicious sand and gravel within 12 blocks glow for 20 seconds, and you hear how many there are.

name: Remedy
description: Cures what ails and turns it to good (poison to Regeneration, slowness to Speed, weakness to Strength...) for half its time; heals 4 and gives Regeneration I for 6 seconds. A zombie villager it touches is weakened, ready for a golden apple.

name: Rend
description: Rends armour: targets lose 4 armour for 10 seconds, and what they naturally resist they take at full strength.

name: Repel
description: A violent outward blast: 4 damage and hurls everything within 3 blocks away (light creatures far, heavy ones barely). On enemies just pulled in, it sets off Collapse.

name: Resonance
description: 5 damage and a cursed mark for 10 seconds. Up to 4 other marked enemies within 16 blocks take half of it too, once each per cast.

name: Resonant Shriek
description: A sculk shriek: 8 damage that ignores armour, a stagger, and Darkness for 6 seconds. A second later it echoes for half as much.

name: Restock
description: Tops up your hotbar stacks from the chest hit.

name: Restore
description: Puts things back: heals 4, puts out fire, and mends 8% of every worn and held item's durability (an item once a minute).

name: Reveal
description: Makes targets glow through walls for 15 seconds, strips their invisibility and leaves them exposed for as long (an arcane mark).

name: Reversal
description: For 30 seconds, one killing blow is reversed: back to half health instead of dying. Once death has been cheated, nothing turns it back again for a minute.

name: Rewind
description: Turns back the clock: return to where you were 5 seconds ago, if it is safe, with the health you had then if it was more.

name: Riftbolt
description: A black bolt for 7 damage that tears the target through a rift up to 5 blocks away, left in Darkness for 3 seconds.

name: Riftcall
description: Opens a rift at the point for 3 seconds: it drags enemies within 5 blocks toward it for 2 damage a second, then snaps shut on them for 6. It gapes wider for every creature it holds (up to 5): half a block of reach and 1 more damage each.

name: Rime Causeway
description: Condenses wind into an ascending three-wide ice causeway. Lasts eight seconds, leaves no farmable ice and cushions allies when it fades.

name: Rime Seal
description: Writes a frost seal 3 blocks across on the ground for 6 seconds. An enemy that stands in it for a second freezes solid for 1.5 seconds (1 on players) and takes 3 damage, once each.

name: Ripen
description: Hurries each crop, stem, berry bush and nether wart in a 5-by-5 patch one stage on (two at 1.5 power, three at most). Ripe ones are left as they are.

name: Riposte
description: For 10 seconds the ally sees the next 2 blows coming: each is sidestepped, and answered at once with the blow's own damage (4 to 12) to whoever struck.

name: Ripple
description: Sunlight through the body: 6 damage, doubled against undead, and you heal a quarter of what it took. Half a second later it ripples out: 3 to every other enemy within 2.5 blocks, and you heal 1 for each.

name: Riser
description: Carves a stair 5 steps up the way you face (iron-pickaxe hardness; Amplify for diamond). Stops short of lava or water.

name: Root
description: Vines hold targets in place for 3 seconds.

name: Root Bulwark
description: Raises a living root wall that gives nearby allies brief Regeneration I. Lasts eight seconds, respects land protections and drops no wood.

name: Root Carry
description: Two separate casts select and move one unchanged young Cinder Fern onto nearby visible soil. Selection lasts fifteen seconds; successful relocation starts a twenty-second rest. Refuses grown, changed, hidden, protected or unloaded roots.

name: Rootsnare
description: Mangrove roots burst up around the point: every enemy within 3 blocks is held for 1.5 seconds and takes 3 damage, then slowed for 4 seconds and cut by 1 damage for every 1.5 blocks it moves (5 at most).

name: Ruin Sense
description: Senses the nearest trail ruins and tells which way and roughly how far. Structure senses share a 30-second rest.

name: Salve
description: Heals 2, gives Regeneration I for 8 seconds and puts out fire.

name: Sanctuary
description: A 6-block circle for 30 seconds: no monster spawns there, and monsters inside are nudged out.

name: Sandbar
description: Raises a 12-block sandstone path at the water's surface the way you look, for 20 seconds.

name: Sandstorm
description: A sandstorm whirls at the point for 4 seconds: every enemy within 3.5 blocks takes 2 damage a second, can't see and is slowed.

name: Sanguine Rite
description: You pay 3 of your own health (never your last; more with Amplify, Overcharge and a crowd) for 12 damage that ignores armour.

name: Sapflow
description: Spring sap rises in you: Regeneration I for 8 seconds.

name: Sapling Rise
description: Saplings and mushrooms in a 5-by-5 patch are urged to grow: up to 3 of them each get the growth of 8 bone meal.

name: Sapling Sow
description: Plants saplings from your own inventory onto open dirt and grass in a 5-by-5 patch, two blocks apart: up to 4.

name: Savor
description: For 5 minutes, food you eat fills you for longer.

name: Scarecrow
description: Stands a ward of rustling wind on the spot for 20 seconds: rabbits, foxes and monsters within 5 blocks are shooed out of it once a second. Pets and farm animals stay put.

name: School Sight
description: Fish, squid, dolphins, turtles and axolotls within 16 blocks of the point glow for 12 seconds.

name: Sea Breeze
description: Clears Mining Fatigue, Nausea and Hunger.

name: Searing Edge
description: For 15 seconds the target's weapon sears: each melee hit it lands sets the foe alight for 4 seconds and deals 2 more fire damage.

name: Second Bell
description: Two visible electrodes ring after one and two seconds. Leaving the marked spot evades the second discharge. Two targets at most, eight total damage per payment after bonuses; no movement hold.

name: Second Wind
description: For 20 seconds, the first blow that would kill the ally leaves them at 4 health instead, with Regeneration II and Speed II for 4 seconds and a gust that shoves enemies away. Once death has been cheated (by this or any other spell), it isn't again on them for a minute.

name: Seethe
description: Traps each target in a bubble of boiling water for 2 seconds (1 fire damage every half second), then it bursts into scalding steam: 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 blocks, blinded for 2 seconds and left soaked.

name: Sentry
description: Monsters within 16 blocks of the target glow for 10 seconds.

name: Shackle
description: Chains each target to the spot for 5 seconds: it's yanked back if it strays more than 2 blocks, and the chain bites for 2.

name: Shades
description: Two shadow hounds rise from your shadow and hunt at your side for 15 seconds. They are frail (20 health) and bite hard only where the light is dim (level 7 or less); each bite leaves its target shadowed.

name: Shadowstep
description: You vanish and reappear right behind the first creature hit, facing its back. Your next blow on it within 3 seconds lands half again as hard.

name: Shard Compass
description: Offer one carried raw iron, copper or gold sample to locate a nearby matching loaded permitted deposit with an accessible side. A successful find spends the sample and points a short graded pebble route; refusal preserves it. Never mines or creates rewards.

name: Shelf Count
description: At an enchanting table: how many bookshelves feed it, out of 15, and how many are blocked.

name: Shellback
description: Resistance for 15 seconds, 30 in water or rain.

name: Shield
description: For 30 seconds, the next harmful spell cast at the target meets magic circles that spawn in front of it and stop it. A spell that cost more mana than the one that raised the Shield shatters them and goes through. The stronger the Shield, the more circles stack.

name: Shieldwall
description: You and allies within 5 blocks can't be knocked back and get Resistance I for 8 seconds.

name: Shipwreck Sense
description: Senses the nearest shipwreck and tells which way and roughly how far. Structure senses share a 30-second rest.

name: Shoal Herd
description: Fish within 10 blocks of the point swim to it for 10 seconds.

name: Shock
description: 4 lightning damage that arcs to one more enemy nearby: it finds a wet or metal-armoured one first.

name: Shore Sense
description: Points to the nearest dry land within 48 blocks.

name: Shore Up
description: Props up hanging sand and gravel near the point with blocks from your pack. 8 at most.

name: Shrug Off
description: Lifts the harmful effect with the most time left.

name: Shulkershell
description: Shuts the target in a shulker's shell for 4 seconds: 80% less damage and no knockback, but it can't move. When it opens, what it turned aside leaves as up to 3 bullets that seek the nearest enemies (6 damage each at most, and they float), and enemies within 3 blocks float up for 2 seconds.

name: Siftfall
description: Sand and gravel hanging over air above the point fall as items, up to 4 high.

name: Sign Glow
description: Makes the writing on signs within 6 blocks glow, front and back.

name: Silence
description: Casters can't cast: a cast in hand is cut short and none can follow for 4 seconds (3 on players). Monsters are weakened for 6 seconds.

name: Silklift
description: Mines the block hit whole, as Silk Touch would. Never a chest or anything with contents.

name: Singularity
description: A black hole opens where it lands for 2.5 seconds, drawing in enemies within 5 blocks and swallowing arrows and bolts, then bursts: 6 damage (1 more for each thing swallowed, up to 5), and they're flung outward.

name: Sinkhole
description: The ground gives way: enemies within 3 blocks are dragged to its middle and pinned for 2 seconds (Slowness IV, no jumping), then crushed for 6 damage.

name: Skater's Edge
description: Speed for 30 seconds, Speed II when standing on ice.

name: Skimstep
description: Run across water for 15 seconds. Crouch to sink.

name: Sky Reading
description: Reads the sky: the weather now and about how many minutes until it turns.

name: Skyburst
description: Flings each target high into the air (3 at most); at the top of its flight it explodes and rains fire down: 7 damage to it and every enemy within 3 blocks of it or beneath it, setting them alight, and the wind that carried it fans the flames (Wildfire). Never breaks blocks.

name: Skyglyph
description: Writes a wind glyph where it lands for 10 seconds: an ally who steps on it is launched high and forward, an enemy thrown back 4 blocks.

name: Skylatch
description: Lifts an ally about one block and holds vertical height for four seconds while lateral movement remains free. Crouch to release into two seconds of gentle descent. Refuses ceilings, flight abilities, anchors and warded arenas. At most eight allies per paid cast; eight-second target rest.

name: Skyread
description: Tells you the weather, how long it will hold, the hour and the moon.

name: Slime Sense
description: Tells whether slimes can spawn underground in this chunk.

name: Slowburn
description: Hunger drains half as fast for 10 minutes. Can be a passive.

name: Sluice
description: Puts out fire within 4 blocks of the point, up to 24 blocks, campfires too, and anything burning there.

name: Smelt
description: Mines the block that was hit and drops it smelted, as a furnace would (iron-pickaxe hardness; Amplify for diamond).

name: Smite
description: A ring closes at the target's feet; 0.7 seconds later a column of light deals 13 holy damage (doubled against undead) and strips Absorption.

name: Smoke Signal
description: A tall column of smoke rises where it lands for 2 minutes.

name: Douse
description: Puts out the candles and campfires within 6 blocks.

name: Snuff Out
description: Puts out fire, campfires and candles within 4 blocks of the point.

name: Soak Through
description: Concrete powder within 2 blocks of the point sets and dirt turns to mud, up to 12 blocks.

name: Soar
description: Wings of wind let you fly for 20 seconds: double-tap jump to take off, then jump and sneak to rise and sink. It can't be renewed mid-flight, and when the wind fades it sets you down gently, then your wings need 30 seconds' rest. A pull or a grounding wind tears it away, and it won't lift anyone in a warded arena.

name: Softfoot
description: For 5 minutes, monsters more than 8 blocks away lose track of you, unless you struck them in the last 10 seconds. Can be a passive.

name: Softsole
description: You don't trample farmland when you jump or step down onto it, for 10 minutes. Can be a passive.

name: Sonic Boom
description: 16 damage that ignores armour, and everything else on the line between you and the target takes 8, through walls.

name: Soothe
description: A neutral creature forgets its anger and its target.

name: Soulbond
description: Binds you and an ally for 10 seconds: any damage either of you takes is split between you. The bond breaks beyond 16 blocks.

name: Soulfire
description: Blue soul flames: 3 fire damage a second for 5 seconds that water can't dull and the fire-proof can't shrug off, and the damage they deal gives you back a little mana (up to 5 a cast).

name: Sounding
description: In water: dive fast for 2 seconds.

name: Sow
description: Plants seeds from your own inventory into the empty farmland of a 5-by-5 patch, one seed for each block. Nothing is planted that you don't carry.

name: Span
description: A bridge of glass grows from your feet toward the point, up to 16 blocks, and shatters 30 seconds later.

name: Spawn Bearing
description: Tells which way the world spawn lies and roughly how far.

name: Spawner Sense
description: Counts the monster and trial spawners within 32 blocks and points to the nearest.

name: Spellbrand
description: Brands each target with a sigil for 8 seconds. The next time your magic hurts it, the sigil bursts for 7 damage of the element of the spell that set it off.

name: Spire Sense
description: In the End, senses the nearest End city and tells which way and roughly how far. Structure senses share a 30-second rest.

name: Spook
description: Enemies flee from you for 3 seconds. Bosses and players are only slowed.

name: Sporebloom
description: Spores burst from a giant mushroom at the point: enemies within 3 blocks take Poison I and spore damage, and monsters among them turn on each other for 5 seconds (players get Nausea). Your allies there get 4 hunger back.

name: Spring Draw
description: Fills an empty bucket in your hand with water. Without one, places a water source where you aim.

name: Springbed
description: Pours one safe Basinfill vessel, then grows up to eight existing bank crops or moist Moonreed buds by one stage. The new water must hydrate their soil. Never creates plants or opens mature Moonreed without pollinators. Once per paid cast.

name: Springseek
description: For 30 seconds, blue motes point to the nearest water source within 24 blocks.

name: Stair Delve
description: Carves a stair 5 steps down the way you face (iron-pickaxe hardness; Amplify for diamond). Stops short of lava, water or a drop.

name: Stalactite
description: A stalactite drops on the spot each target stands on: 7 damage, 30% more against a bare head. Step aside and it misses.

name: Stalkrise
description: Sugar cane and cactus in a 5-by-5 patch grow one block taller, never past three tall; bamboo grows as bone meal would grow it.

name: Stand Pose
description: Armor stands within 6 blocks gain arms and step to their next pose.

name: Starchart
description: Tells you where you are, which way you face, and how far it is to spawn.

name: Starfall
description: Eight falling stars around the point over 2 seconds: 6 damage each. The first stars go to exposed enemies.

name: Starfire
description: Five motes of starfire seek up to five enemies within 6 blocks: 2 damage each, and they burn for 3 seconds.

name: Starlight Tether
description: Tethers each target to the point with a thread of starlight for 5 seconds: it's dragged back if it strays 3 blocks, taking 1 damage each time (once a second at most).

name: Starmaw
description: Devours the light: 14 damage, and it swallows each of the target's good effects and wards (Foresight, Riposte, Reflect, Reversal, Infinity, Anchor) for 4 more damage apiece, and its absorption for 1 per heart.

name: Starshard
description: A shard of the fallen star: 11 damage, then it splinters into 3 sparks that strike the nearest other enemies within 8 blocks for 4.

name: Stasis
description: Time stops for everything hit for 5 seconds. Every hit meanwhile is held, then lands all at once when time moves again.

name: Staunch
description: Ends poison and wither and keeps them off for 10 seconds.

name: Steady Brush
description: With a brush in hand, brushes up to 3 suspicious blocks near the point at once, hands free. The brush wears a point for each.

name: Steam
description: A scalding burst of steam: 5 damage and Blindness for 3 seconds, and a cloud hangs where it burst: everything in it is blinded and left wet.

name: Steedmend
description: Your mount, or the animal it touches, regenerates for 3 minutes.

name: Steedsong
description: Your mount, or the animal it touches, gets Speed II and Jump Boost II for 3 minutes.

name: Stewpot
description: Cooks bowls from your inventory into stew, as a crafting table would: a red and a brown mushroom make mushroom stew, six beetroots make beetroot soup. Up to 3 bowls.

name: Stillbind
description: Holds the target in place for 3 seconds without harm. Bosses are only slowed.

name: Stillwell
description: For 5 minutes, standing still for 3 seconds slowly refills your mana, up to 12.

name: Stilt
description: Raises you on a packed mud column up to 5 high. It crumbles after 30 seconds.

name: Stitchtime
description: Heals the ally 4 and stitches the next 4 seconds: every wound they take meanwhile is counted, and when the time is up it all heals back at once (12 at most).

name: Stocktake
description: Tells you the biggest stocks across the chests within 4 blocks of the point.

name: Stoneform
description: For 8 seconds: no knockback, 20% less damage, and every blow you take from an attacker sends out an aftershock (at most once a second).

name: Stoneskin
description: Resistance II for 10 seconds, and Slowness I: stone is heavy.

name: Storm Glass
description: Tells how long until the weather turns.

name: Stormclock
description: 4 damage, and lightning strikes the same spot again 2 and 4 seconds later: 3 damage to enemies within 1.5 blocks each time.

name: Stormheart
description: For 10 seconds, whatever hurts you (a blow of 2 or more) is struck by lightning (at most once a second).

name: Stormweave
description: Marks up to 4 enemies within 6 blocks; a moment later lightning weaves between them all: 4 damage each, and 1 more for every other one caught in the web; a target alone takes 2 more.

name: Stoutheart
description: Resistance I for 10 seconds (Amplify makes it II).

name: Stow
description: Moves pack items the chest hit already holds into it. Your hotbar stays.

name: Strata Rise
description: Raises a real five-wide, three-high stone wall over seven ticks. Lasts eight seconds, drops no material, respects protected land and cannot trap creatures.

name: Stronghold Compass
description: In the Overworld, tells which way the nearest stronghold lies, but never how far. Structure senses share a 30-second rest.

name: Summit Wind
description: A howling mountain wind: 5 damage and hurls every enemy within 3 blocks up and away, holding them aloft so they glide down out of the fight (a fifth stronger above y=120). On Self it carries you 12 blocks up and lets you glide down.

name: Summon
description: Three spirit wolves fight at your side for 20 seconds. While they live, your mana regenerates a quarter slower.

name: Sun Reading
description: Tells the time of day and how many minutes until dusk or dawn.

name: Sunbask
description: For 10 minutes, open daylight heals you a point every 6 seconds while nothing hurts you.

name: Sunscorch
description: The noon sun, focused: 8 fire damage and alight for 5 seconds, and the target glows for 6. Under open sky by day it burns 50% hotter and blinds; bright light of its own counts as dusk (25% hotter).

name: Surefoot
description: Step up full blocks without jumping for 5 minutes. Can be a passive.

name: Surge
description: Speed I and Strength I for 8 seconds; the blows you land in that time arc on to a nearby enemy for 2 (four arcs at most).

name: Swap
description: You and the first creature hit trade places, instantly.

name: Swift
description: Speed III for 10 seconds, and it shakes off Slowness and frozen skin.

name: Tackle Mend
description: Mends 16 durability of a held fishing rod, more with Power.

name: Tarry
description: For 5 minutes, your good effects run down at half speed.

name: Taunt
description: Enemies hit turn on you for 6 seconds, and you get Resistance I for as long.

name: Tempest
description: A lightning strike for 8 damage, and a gale that hurls targets far away; where they come down a second bolt strikes for 4.

name: Tend
description: Heals a villager, golem, pet or animal for 8 (an iron golem for 16).

name: Thawfield
description: A warm breath melts the snow layers in a 5-by-5 patch away from crops and soil. Snow blocks and ice are left alone.

name: Thresherwind
description: Three travelling shear lanes harvest up to nine mature crops ahead of the impact. Replants only by consuming a real seed from each crop's drops. Collects this harvest, preserves full-inventory leftovers, respects loaded land and claims. Once per paid cast.

name: Thunder Tide
description: Suspends real borrowed water inside electrical rings and drives it forward. Each enemy takes 5 damage once, is soaked and slowed for one second. Water returns safely.

name: Thunder Walk
description: Builds five copper-lit wind stepping stones. Each enemy touching a stone takes 2 magic damage once per cast; allies receive slow falling before expiry.

name: Thunderbird
description: A storm bird circles above you for 12 seconds. Every 2 seconds it marks the enemy you last hit (or the nearest within 12 blocks) and dives on that spot for 4.5 damage: step aside and it misses. Two at most.

name: Thunderclap
description: A flash, then a crack of thunder: 5 damage within 3 blocks, and everything hit is stunned for half a second and, if it is a monster, forgets who it was hunting.

name: Thunderhead
description: A thundercloud gathers over the target for 4 seconds and strikes an enemy within 4 blocks of it every second: 2 damage, and the rain soaks it so the bolt conducts.

name: Thunderquake
description: The ground booms like thunder: three shockwaves roll out from where it lands over a second, reaching 2, 4 and 6 blocks. Each strikes every enemy it reaches for 4 and tosses it up, so the nearer, the harder: 12 at the heart.

name: Thunderstep
description: You come down as a bolt of lightning where the spell landed (up to 24 blocks), right behind the first enemy it hit: 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 blocks of you, stunned for half a second. On Self it strikes where you stand.

name: Tidal Lift
description: Borrows up to three real water sources within four blocks, lifts them along a ten-block arc, then returns them. Each enemy takes 4 damage once and is soaked for five seconds. Needs nearby source water.

name: Tide Lantern
description: A light at the point for 60 seconds that shines under water too.

name: Tide Marker
description: Sets a glowing buoy at the point for 5 minutes and tells you where it is. One per caster.

name: Tidebreath
description: Water breathing and faster swimming for 30 seconds, and it douses you: fire goes out, and fire hits are softer while you drip.

name: Tidecall
description: The tide crashes in at the point: 6 damage to every enemy within 3.5 blocks, dragging them into the middle (as a Pull does) and leaving them soaked. A crowd it bunches takes 1 more for each neighbour (4 at most).

name: Tidehook
description: A hook of water snags each target and reels it in to your feet in three tugs (a flyer is reeled down): 4 damage, it's left soaked and gasping for half a second when it lands.

name: Tidewrit
description: Writes the tide: a 7-wide wall of water rolls from you through the point, 10 damage to everything in it, sweeping it about 11 blocks on, soaked.

name: Tillage
description: Tills the dirt and grass in a 5-by-5 patch around the block it strikes into farmland, as a hoe would. Widen reaches further; never more than 32 blocks a cast.

name: Tilth
description: Loosens the coarse and rooted dirt in a 5-by-5 patch into plain dirt; rooted dirt sheds its hanging roots, as a hoe would.

name: Time Skip
description: Time skips ahead: you vanish, reappear up to 8 blocks forward on safe ground, and nearby monsters lose track of you. For a moment after, nothing can hurt you (not again for 5 seconds).

name: Timesteal
description: Steals up to 2 of the target's good effects, with the time they had left (at most 30 seconds), and gives them to you. With nothing to steal it steals a moment: the target drags, and you are quickened, for 2 seconds.

name: Tinker's Hum
description: For 5 minutes, a worn tool or piece of armor you carry mends a point every 10 seconds, up to 30.

name: Tool Mend
description: Mends the tool in the target's hand with its repair material from your pack: a quarter for each, 4 at most.

name: Torchfall
description: Sets up to 6 torches from your pack on the darkest floor near the point, 5 blocks apart.

name: Trade Renew
description: A villager with a trade restocks every offer. Each villager only once a day.

name: Trail Blaze
description: Sets a glowing end rod on the face it hits for 5 minutes, to mark the way back. It drops nothing.

name: Trailblaze
description: For 10 minutes, you leave green crumbs every 6 blocks that only you can see. Up to 40.

name: Transfusion
description: You give up to 4 of your own health (never below 2), and the ally heals three times what you gave and is cured of one harmful effect.

name: Treasure Sense
description: For 60 seconds, Luck II, and the nearest unopened treasure chests and suspicious blocks within 24 blocks sparkle now and then.

name: Tremor
description: The ground erupts: 8 damage to enemies within 4 blocks, throwing them up.

name: Trot
description: Your mount (or the horse you strike) gets Speed II and Jump Boost I for 20 seconds. Cast on yourself while riding.

name: Truce
description: Every enemy within 8 blocks is pacified for 4 seconds. Not bosses.

name: Tunnel
description: Bores a tunnel 2 high and 4 deep into the wall that was hit (up to iron-pickaxe hardness; Amplify for diamond).

name: Tusk Charge
description: You charge like a hoglin, up to 8 blocks the way you look, tossing everything in your path into the air: 3 damage, and 0.8 more for every block you ran up (9 at most).

name: Twin Star
description: Your next spell within 6 seconds is cast twice.

name: Umbra
description: The dark bites: 4 damage, doubled where the light is dim (level 7 or less, or under an Eclipse), and it leaves the target shadowed.

name: Unburden
description: Moves your whole pack into the chest hit, as far as it has room. Your hotbar stays.

name: Undertow
description: Drags each target down: Slowness III for 3 seconds and soaked. Out of the water it hauls the target toward the nearest water within 6 blocks (with none near, the ground turns to slurry for 3 damage); in water it's pulled under and takes 5.

name: Unpack
description: Turns up to 4 storage blocks in your pack back into nine pieces each.

name: Updraft
