description: Hurls enemies within 2.5 blocks high into the air, where every spell hits them harder; a moment later a downdraft smashes them back down for 4 damage.

name: Upwell
description: In water: rush up toward the surface.

name: Veil
description: Invisibility for 12 seconds, and nearby monsters lose track of you. The first damage you deal from it lands half again as hard, and ends it.

name: Vein
description: Mines the block that was hit and, if it's an ore, every matching ore joined to it (up to 16; iron-pickaxe hardness; Amplify for diamond).

name: Venom
description: 2 damage now and 0.75 a second for 4 seconds, with Poison I: it can kill and works on undead and spiders. The poisoned pass it on, once, to up to 3 enemies within 2.5 blocks.

name: Village Sense
description: Senses the nearest village and tells which way and roughly how far. Structure senses share a 30-second rest.

name: Vinelash
description: A thorned vine lashes each target: 5 damage, and it's yanked 4 blocks toward you and tripped (Slowness II for 2 seconds).

name: Void Step
description: A platform of end stone forms under your feet and crumbles from the edge after 6 seconds.

name: Warcry
description: A war horn sounds: you and your allies within 8 blocks of the target gain Strength I and Speed I for 12 seconds, and each kill one of you makes meanwhile heals that one for 1.

name: Warm Cloak
description: You can't freeze for 10 minutes, even in powder snow. Can be a passive.

name: Warp
description: You and the first creature hit swap places through the void, and you come out unseen for a second. An enemy is left pulled and reeling: Slowness II and Nausea for 2 seconds.

name: Warp Step
description: Steps you to where the spell landed (up to 24 blocks). 3 seconds later you're pulled back, unless you're sneaking.

name: Watchweft
description: Watches a visible dry floor for forty-five seconds. Gives its owner one private warning only after a visible monster targeting them crosses into three blocks in consecutive complete samples. Remain within sixteen blocks; ninety-second rest.

name: Water Reading
description: Tells whether your bobber sits in open water (needed for treasure) and whether rain is speeding up bites.

name: Wayfarer's Hymn
description: You and allies within 10 blocks get Speed I and Jump Boost I for 3 minutes. It ends for anyone who strikes.

name: Wayline
description: Latch a short line to owned safe ground within six blocks. Hold forward for a bounded two-second tow; crouch to release. Normal collision remains, no one else is moved, and no flight ability is granted.

name: Waymark
description: Raises a pillar of light only you can see, from 160 blocks, for 10 minutes. Up to 3 at once.

name: Weigh
description: Crushingly heavy for 5 seconds: triple gravity, barely able to move or jump, and fliers are dragged down.

name: Whistle
description: Your pets within 48 blocks that aren't sitting or leashed come to your side.

name: Wildflower
description: Sows wild flowers onto the open grass in a 5-by-5 patch: up to 6 flowers, more when widened.

name: Wind Steps
description: Forms five real wind platforms ahead, ascending one block every two steps. Lasts eight seconds; allies standing on expiring steps get three seconds of slow falling.

name: Windcut
description: A cutting wind: 4 damage and a light shove, and it breaks what the target is winding up: a charge, a bow's draw, a creeper's fuse, a spell.

name: Withdraw
description: An ally below half health turns invisible with Speed II for 4 seconds, and its hunters lose track of it.

name: Wither
description: Wither IV for 6 seconds: it spreads to whoever strikes it in melee, and the withered can't heal.

name: Worst First
description: Heals the most hurt ally within 8 blocks of where it lands (you too) for 6.

name: Wreck Sense
description: Chests and barrels under water and suspicious sand and gravel within 20 blocks shine for 15 seconds, up to 12.

name: Wring
description: Soaks up water like a sponge within 2 blocks of the point, up to 24 blocks.

name: Zephyr
description: A warm breeze that clears the air: allies within 4 blocks get Speed I, Jump Boost I and Regeneration I for 10 seconds, and it blows away blindness, darkness, nausea and slowness.

name: Zipper
description: Unzips the wall in front of you and steps you through up to 6 blocks of solid wall (never one that isn't yours to open).
